data-expertforum.rezultat: Portal of data sets that Expert Forum (EFOR) compiled for its projects. The page is a copy that the owner saved from their browser on 2026-10-26 (expertforum.ro and its subdomains are on the list of hosts that no script requests). It lists 15 data sets in five categories (Electoral 4, Finanțare politică 1, Infrastructură 6, Media 1, Sănătate 3). Each has a subcategory, a title, a description, related EFOR reports and a link. Eleven data sets link 14 Google Sheet tabs, one links a Drive file (political finance) and three share one Drive folder (health procurement). The pass read each of the 14 tabs once, through its CSV export (docs.google.com, no retry): 10 were parsed (100 field records, one for each header cell) and 4 answered with more than 2,000,000 bytes and were not parsed. Three tabs needed a header option (a title above the header, empty header cells). The page declares no column, no period, no licence and no named institution; it says that EFOR processed the data from public information or from information obtained under the access-to-information law, and it asks the user to cite the source. The facts of the page (category, title, description, reports, the label of a link) have exact locators in the registry and in the data set list of the page source. One provider is named in the evidence: the tab of HG 1088/2021 has a column `sursa` that holds „HG 1088/2021” in every row, and the page labels the second tab „HG 1264/2021 (Ciucă)” (review item D186). Three groups are proposed (`uat`, `partid-politic`, `beneficiar-fonduri-publice`) and eight selectors are listed as candidates for five reviewed groups (`siruta`, `cui`, `judet`, `localitate`, `voturi-valide`). Relation to another entry: the political finance data set has the related report https://www.banipartide.ro/ on the page. It is a relation between the two entries, not a source of either.
data-expertforum.limite_en: Four tabs are over 2,000,000 bytes and were not parsed. A Drive file and a Drive folder (three health data sets) were not requested. Tabs about persons keep the header only. The tabs declare no type, unit or description; the header is the only evidence.
data-expertforum.urmator_en: Decide whether a tab over 2,000,000 bytes may be read with a bounded request for its header (--sample-bytes; Google ignores the byte range, so the start of the response is read). Decide the eight candidate selectors, the three proposed groups and D186. The owner can save the Drive file and the folder from a browser if the headers are wanted.

The Drive file (political finance) and the Drive folder (health) were not requested: the page does not say that the file is a spreadsheet, a folder cannot be listed without the API, and the finance data set has donor data about persons.

bani-partide.rezultat: Platform on political party finance in Romania since 2006 (donations, campaign finance, public subsidies, income and expenses of parties; catalogue text). Every automated request to banipartide.ro answers HTTP 403, and the host is on the list of hosts that no script requests. The owner saved the listing of its Datasette database (`https://db.banipartide.ro/banipartide.json`) from a browser on 2026-10-26 at 20:30 (+02:00), and the inventory reads that copy (part 3, brief section 8.1). The listing names the database `banipartide` (46,718,976 bytes) with 18 visible tables, 20 hidden full-text tables and 4 views (names only). The 18 tables have 172 columns, one field record for each, and 457,900 rows in all. The largest are `Donatori rapoarte de venituri și cheltuieli` (353,473 rows), `Contributii campanie` (49,697), `Donatori persoane fizice` (30,791), `Cheltuieli subventii` (8,950) and `Venituri anuale din rapoarte de venituri și cheltuieli` (3,923). The listing declares the source „Expert Forum”, the source address https://expertforum.ro/tag/finantare-politica/ and the licence CC Attribution 4.0, and the field browser credits them. It declares no type, description, unit, period or provider, so each field has a name and nothing more. The tables of donors and `Contributii campanie` hold data about persons (`Nume donator`, `CNP`, `Nume`): the inventory keeps the column names only and no row was read. Mapping: the column `Partid` of 12 tables is proposed for the group `partid-politic` and `Legenda partide.UAT` for `uat` (both groups still proposed); two groups are new (`subventie-partid`, `donatie-partid`, state `propus`); six selectors are candidates for the reviewed groups `cui`, `judet` and `perioada-de-referinta`. Providers: one proposal (D187). The table `Venituri anuale partide de la MF` names the Ministry of Finance by its initials; no other text of the copy names a provider. The source „Expert Forum” is the project author and distributor, not a provider. Relation to another entry: the political finance data set of `data-expertforum` links https://www.banipartide.ro/ as its related report; the two entries share no data source (the Drive file of that data set was not read), so nothing is counted twice.
bani-partide.limite_en: The listing declares column names and row counts only: no type, description, unit, period or provider. The four views have no columns, and the 20 hidden tables get no field. Tables of donors hold data about persons, so only the column names are kept and no row was read. The home page and the documentation pages of the project were not read (HTTP 403; host on the list).
bani-partide.urmator_en: Decide D187, the two proposed groups, the new members of the proposed groups `partid-politic` and `uat`, and the six candidate selectors for the reviewed groups `cui`, `judet` and `perioada-de-referinta`. The owner can save the JSON pages of the views (assumed to list their columns; not verified) and the documentation pages of the project (to look for AEP and Monitorul Oficial in their text).

romania-interactiva.rezultat: Platform of public tools by three lecturers of FSPAC, Babeș-Bolyai University: its home page lists 22 tools, six on the project host and the others on their own hosts. The pass read seven: the census tool (county population at eight censuses, 1948–2021), the governments timeline (28 governments), the university centres tool (students per centre and per university), the marriages and divorces map (counties, 1990–2024), the local elections map and the exam results map (both over 2,000,000 bytes, read as samples), and Orașe digitale (the e-government index of 325 cities). Each tool keeps its data in the page: script constants, a JSON data island and one HTML table. The new reader `js-literale` lists them with the types of a bounded sample; the JSON-LD `Dataset` of every page gives its name, period, licence and `isBasedOn`. Every page ends with a "Surse" or "Date" note that names its providers: INS (TEMPO matrices SCL103D, POP210A, POP212A, POP107A and census tables), Eurostat, CNFIS, AEP, the Ministry of Education (via data.gov.ro), Guvernul României, Monitorul Oficial and Agerpres; the dormitory data come from an ANOSR analysis and a Cushman & Wakefield Echinox study. Three INS matrices were read as metadata. Orașe digitale is the authors' own collection (manual coding of 46 indicators in five categories, three waves); the page names no source for the population of a city. The pages declare no field types, no units and no field descriptions, except six `variableMeasured` entries of Orașe digitale.
romania-interactiva.limite_en: Seven of 22 catalogue tools were read. Two pages are samples of 600,000 bytes (no data). Field records come from a bounded sample of script literals; short key names are not described by the pages.
romania-interactiva.urmator_en: Decide whether a response over 2,000,000 bytes may be read whole; choose more tools from the 15 that were not read (1vot.ro, geamanuleuropean.ro, sondajeleromaniei.ro, satulcaresestinge.ro); decide on the candidate selectors for the reviewed groups.
romania-interactiva.blocaj_en: The data of the local elections and exam results pages is beyond the 2,000,000-byte limit of the fetcher; the population of a city in Orașe digitale has no named source.

lista-firme.rezultat: Search by CUI or name over the Romanian companies, with an API (catalogue: `format:api`) and the repository `tudorr89/info-firme`. The API has no documentation page. The repository README (commit 1dcb375, 2026-10-24) documents `GET https://lista-firme.info/api/v1/info?cui=...` and `?name=...`; the code reads `company` and not `name`. The routes file has the one route `info` and a fallback that aborts any other API path with 401 (by the code; not requested). Neither the README nor the routes file mentions a key. The six migrations read give 51 field records (the columns of `companies`, `addresses`, `infos` and `statuses`). The terms page names the originators: ONRC (via data.gov.ro) and the public ANAF APIs. On 2026-10-27 the owner raised the request limit of the entry for one request. `GET /api/v1/info?cui=51859625` (the CUI of the operator) answered HTTP 200 with 2,276 bytes of JSON; it needed no key. It is the seventh source, with 57 field records (55 before 2026-10-27: the corrected reader adds the two empty lists as two records): key paths and observed types, no value. The response has 17 keys. Nine are columns of `companies` (`name`, `cui`, `euid`, `registration_date`, `type`, `website`, `parent_country`, `mark`, `reg_com`). One is computed: `is_active` (the scope `preferActive` of the model adds it in the query; it is not a column). Seven are relations: `address` (12 keys), `info`, `status`, `caen`, `legal_representatives`, `natural_person_representatives` and `eu_branches`. Against the migrations the API hides `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` of `companies`, and `id`, `company_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` of `addresses`. `status` holds only `details` (`code` and `description`): none of the five `statuses` columns read appears. The relation `caen` has three elements, each with `code`, `version` and the same seven keys under `caen_details` and `details`. The relation `legal_representatives` has one element with 14 keys, among them the name, the birth date and place and the current location of a natural person. It keeps `id`, `company_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`: the API hides keys of this kind for the company and the address. For this company `info` is null, so the 18 columns of `infos` were not observed. `natural_person_representatives` and `eu_branches` are empty lists (each is a field of the type array with 0 elements), so the keys of their elements are unknown. Three candidate members are proposed for the reviewed groups `cui`, `judet` and `localitate`: the paths `$.cui`, `$.address.county` and `$.address.city` of the response. The two provider items D189 and D190 are decided. A group for the CAEN code is a suggestion only (section 5).

Relația `info` este nulă, deci cele 18 coloane ale tabelului `infos` nu au fost observate. `natural_person_representatives` și `eu_branches` sunt liste goale, deci cheile lor nu sunt cunoscute. Cheia `mark` a fost doar nulă, deci tipul ei nu este cunoscut.

Citirea migrărilor dă coloanele tabelelor, nu cheile răspunsului. Doar migrarea de creare a tabelelor `addresses`, `infos` și `statuses` a fost citită; migrările ulterioare ale tabelului `statuses` (două) nu au fost citite. Tabelele reprezentanților legali, ale reprezentanților persoane fizice, ale sucursalelor și ale codurilor CAEN nu au fost citite (limita de 15 cereri). Răspunsul arată cheile relațiilor `caen` și `legal_representatives`, nu coloanele tabelelor lor.

Răspunsul conține date despre o persoană fizică: nume, data și locul nașterii, locația curentă. Inventarul păstrează numele cheilor și tipurile observate, nu valorile. Termenii site-ului interzic colectarea în masă, deci nu s-a făcut o a doua cerere.
README-ul spune `?name=`, iar codul citește `company`: documentația și codul nu coincid. Interogarea după nume nu a fost cerută.

dupa-cutremur.urmatorul_pas: Decideți D203 și D204, grupul propus `coordonate-geografice` și candidatul pentru `localitate`. Dacă vreți coloanele seturilor csv, proprietarul poate exporta folderul Drive dintr-un browser și îl poate importa cu `inventory.py --import-saved`.
dupa-cutremur.urmator_en: Decide D203 and D204, the proposed group `coordonate-geografice` and the candidate for `localitate`. The owner can export the Drive folder from a browser and import it with `inventory.py --import-saved` if the columns of the csv sets are wanted.

limite: Pachetul de date are mai mult de 2.000 de căi; limita de 2.000 de câmpuri și cea de 25 de elemente se aplică, deci registrul celor 136 de baze de date este citit ca eșantion.

Contractele sunt citate prin numere SICAP; exporturile SICAP nu au fost cerute.
statul-digital.limite_en: The bundle has more than 2,000 paths; the bounds of 2,000 fields and 25 elements apply, so the register of 136 databases is read as a sample. Field names are in Romanian and English (`titleRo`, `titleEn`) and repeat the content. The contracts are cited by SICAP number; no SICAP export was requested.
statul-digital.urmatorul_pas: Decideți D208 și candidatul pentru `localitate` (orașul unui centru de date).
statul-digital.urmator_en: Decide D208 and the candidate for `localitate` (the city of a data centre).

pe-datorie.rezultat: Report by Marius Comper on how much of every 100 lei collected the state spends, borrows and pays as interest, compared with Poland, Hungary and the EU average (catalogue type `publicatie`). The page holds its data in a JSON island (`pd-data`: spent, borrowed, interest and the shares by function for each country and year, 2001–2024) and in two tables (the shares by function; the deficit as a percent of GDP by year and prime minister). 1 source, 68 field records. The page names the Eurostat tables gov_10a_main, gov_10a_exp and gov_10dd_edpt1, the rating agencies and the Government. Eurostat, the Government, the Council of the EU, S&P and Moody's are already accepted providers of this entry; Fitch Ratings is proposed (D210). The deficit column joins the proposed group `deficit-bugetar`; the year column is a candidate for `perioada-de-referinta`.
limite: Cheile anilor și ale țărilor (2001–2024, RO, PL, HU, UE27) sunt valori, nu câmpuri: cititorul le tratează ca o colecție cu chei.
Codurile de funcții (GF01, GF04, GF07 …) sunt cheile COFOG ale tabelului Eurostat gov_10a_exp; pagina nu le definește în insula de date.
Tabelele Eurostat nu au fost cerute.
pe-datorie.limite_en: The keys for years and countries (2001–2024; RO, PL, HU, EU27) are values, not fields: the reader treats them as a keyed collection. The function codes (GF01, GF04, GF07 …) are the COFOG keys of Eurostat gov_10a_exp; the data island does not define them. The Eurostat tables were not requested.
pe-datorie.urmatorul_pas: Decideți D210, grupul propus `deficit-bugetar` și candidatul pentru `perioada-de-referinta`.
pe-datorie.urmator_en: Decide D210, the proposed group `deficit-bugetar` and the candidate for `perioada-de-referinta`.

ce-face-statul-cu-1000-de-lei.rezultat: Explainer by Marius Comper on what the Romanian state does with each 1,000 lei collected, 2015–2025 (catalogue: `format:vizualizare`). The page script loads `data/budget-romania.json` (132,127 characters), which declares its source: Ministry of Finance, Annex 2 (summary of the execution of the consolidated general budget), December notes 2015–2025. 1 source, 34 field records (333 before 2026-10-27: about 30 paths repeated for each of the 11 years; the year keys are now one keyed collection, `$.years{*}`). The count is a path count, not a count of variables. The file has revenue, expenditure, deficit (in million lei and percent of GDP), GDP, the units per 1,000 lei and the categories. The deficit fields join the proposed group `deficit-bugetar`. One provider item (D209).
limite: Cele 34 de câmpuri sunt căi, nu variabile. Anii sunt chei ale colecției `years{*}` (11 membri); înainte de 2026-10-27 cititorul dădea 333 de câmpuri, calea repetată pentru fiecare an.
Unitatea `mil_lei` și `pct_pib` vine din sufixul numelui; fișierul declară definiția unității de 1.000 de lei doar în `unit_definition`.
Pagina oficială a Ministerului Finanțelor (execuția bugetară) nu a fost cerută.
ce-face-statul-cu-1000-de-lei.limite_en: The 34 field records are paths, not variables. The years are the keys of the collection `years{*}` (11 members); before 2026-10-27 the reader gave 333 field records, the path repeated for each year (`years.2015.…`). The units `mil_lei` and `pct_pib` come from the name suffix; the file declares the unit of 1,000 lei in `unit_definition` only. The official page of the Ministry of Finance was not requested.
ce-face-statul-cu-1000-de-lei.urmator_en: Decide D209 and the proposed group `deficit-bugetar`.

monitor-safe.rezultat: Live monitor of the EU SAFE defence loan applied to Romania, 16.68 billion euro (catalogue: `relatie_date` `date-publice`). The project publishes `llms.txt` (key figures, each with a source, the legal framework, the contract tables), a home page and a contract register that hold their data as literals of the page script, and an RSS feed. Two sources were read. The home page (47 field records) holds the six domains, the infrastructure lots, the MAI and SRI plans and projects, the 21 army projects, a timeline of 54 events with a source link for each, and the suppliers. Its literals sit inside a function that wraps the script, so the new reader option `indentate` names the eight declarations. The contract register (49 field records) holds `C`, one record for each contract (value, beneficiary, signing date, status, approved value, promised localisation, events with their sources), and `F`, `NS`, `ST`, `SCURT`. The JSON-LD of the home page declares a schema.org Dataset (period 2026-05-29/2027-12-31) with one distribution, the RSS feed `safe-rss.xml`; the feed mirrors the timeline and no XML reader exists, so it is not a source. llms.txt says that a CSV with all contracts and the CUI of each supplier exists on request by e-mail; it is not public. A comment of the script names `pipeline/safe.json` as the source of the data. The repository that llms.txt links (`Andreim14/companii-stat`) answered 404 to the GitHub API, so the file was not read. Four provider items: D211 MApN, D212 MAI, D213 Senatul României, D214 Monitorul Oficial. No candidate member and no group: the measures are values in millions of euro and the pages have no CUI, county or locality field.
limite: Datele sunt literale ale scriptelor paginilor; nu există fișier, schemă sau descriere de câmp. Pagina scrie valorile în „mil €”, dar câmpul `mil` nu declară unitatea.
Fluxul RSS (`safe-rss.xml`), singura distribuție declarată în JSON-LD, nu are cititor (XML) și oglindește cronologia. CSV-ul cu contractele și CUI-urile furnizorilor se dă doar la cerere prin e-mail.
Depozitul legat în llms.txt (`Andreim14/companii-stat`) a răspuns 404 la API-ul GitHub; fișierul `pipeline/safe.json` din comentariul scriptului nu a fost citit.
Eșantion de 25 de elemente pe listă: `TIMELINE` are 54 de evenimente, `PROIECTE` 21; inventarul arată cheile, nu numărul total.
Pagina de acorduri (`/acorduri/`) are carduri HTML fără tabel și nu a fost citită ca sursă.
monitor-safe.limite_en: The data are literals of the page scripts; no file, schema or field description exists. The page writes values in „mil €”, but the field `mil` declares no unit. The RSS feed, the one distribution that the JSON-LD declares, has no reader (XML) and mirrors the timeline. The CSV of contracts with supplier CUIs exists only on request by e-mail. The repository that llms.txt links answered 404, so `pipeline/safe.json` was not read. The sample bound of 25 elements applies. The agreements page has cards, not a table, and was not read as a source.
monitor-safe.urmatorul_pas: Citiți `pipeline/safe.json` dacă proprietarul publică depozitul. Cereți CSV-ul de contracte (cu CUI) sau un export. Un cititor pentru fluxul RSS ar arăta structura evenimentelor. Decideți elementele D211–D214.
monitor-safe.urmator_en: Read `pipeline/safe.json` if the owner publishes the repository; ask for the CSV of contracts with CUI or an export; a reader for the RSS feed would show the event structure. Decide D211–D214.

igov.rezultat: Civic platform that turns public data, documents and press into verifiable reports (catalogue: `date-publice`). The methodology page says that the derived data files of the reports are public and keep the address and the SHA-256 of each original file. The governance report loads three files, found by reading the page code (the first guess at `/guvernanta.json` returned an HTML page: the page is in `/reports/`; three requests lost). They were read as 150,000-byte samples. `guvernanta.json` (88 field records) holds the sources with address, hash and date, the declared names of the positions of the rows of `appointments` (11) and `state_companies` (12), 121 companies (CUI, authority, turnover, net result, equity, employees, debts) and the people and appointments. `guvernanta-series.json` (18) holds companies keyed by CUI with ten-year series of net result, turnover, revenues, expenses, debts, receivables, equity and employees, and declares its unit: „mii lei; employees: persoane”. `guvernanta-achizitii.json` (31) holds the periods, the rules that the report applied and the 21 files that it read, and buyers keyed by CUI with their top suppliers. The reports page loads two list endpoints, `/api/channels` and `/api/institutions` (17 and 11 field records). The companies keyed by CUI came out of the cut samples only after a new rule of the sample reader (a cut keyed collection keeps its whole members). Six provider items D215–D220 (Guvernul României, Ministerul Finanțelor via data.gov.ro, AMEPIP, SEAP, the European Commission and the Consiliul Concurenței for state aid). Candidate members for `cui`, `cifra-afaceri`, `profit-net`, `numar-salariati` and `perioada-de-referinta`, and members of the new proposed groups `datorii` and `capitaluri-proprii`.
limite: Fișierele sunt eșantioane de 150.000 de octeți. Seria are 265 de companii în eșantion, dar numărul total nu este cunoscut.

`guvernanta.json` conține nume de persoane (membri ai consiliilor de administrație). Sursa nu este marcată `persoane`: cititorul păstrează doar nume de câmpuri (88 de înregistrări, nicio valoare, nicio cheie în afara celor permise), iar marcajul ar face ca verificarea scurgerilor să semnaleze 7 fișiere care conțin nume de instituții. Proprietarul poate marca sursa.
Pozițiile rândurilor `appointments` (11 celule) și `authorities` au nume declarate în `fields`, dar cititorul JSON nu le folosește: câmpurile sunt `appointments[][0]`…`[][10]`.
API-ul are alte rute (`/api/channel/…`, `/api/post/…`, `/api/institution-pack/…`) pentru textul rapoartelor; nu au fost cerute.
igov.limite_en: The files are 150,000-byte samples; the total number of companies is unknown. `guvernanta.json` holds names of board members. The source is not marked `persoane`: the reader keeps names of fields only (88 records, no value, no key beyond the allowed ones), and the mark would make the leak check flag 7 tracked files that hold names of institutions; the owner can mark it. The positions of `appointments` have names declared in `fields`, but the JSON reader does not use them. The other API routes (report text) were not requested.
igov.urmatorul_pas: Decideți dacă `guvernanta.json` se marchează `persoane`. Decideți D215–D220, cei cinci candidați și grupurile `datorii` și `capitaluri-proprii`. Un cititor care folosește lista `fields` ca nume ale pozițiilor ar da nume câmpurilor `appointments[][n]`.
igov.urmator_en: Decide whether `guvernanta.json` is marked `persoane`; decide D215–D220, the candidate members and the groups `datorii` and `capitaluri-proprii`. A reader that takes the list `fields` as the names of positions would name `appointments[][n]`.

companii-publice-ro.rezultat: Map and tree of the public enterprises (catalogue: `date-publice`; a GitHub Pages site, `cosettechichirau.github.io/companiipublice/`). The page fetches three files; they were read as range samples (200,000 bytes; 30,000 for the boundary layer). `companii.json` (18 field records) holds, for each enterprise, the CUI, the name, the level (local or central), the county code and name, the CUI and name of the tutelary authority, the type, the legal form, the state, the CAEN code and name, the parent company and the lists; it declares its source (the list of public enterprises monitored by the Ministry of Finance, O.M.F.P. 2873/2016) and the date of the list. `financials.json` (11) holds the years 2008–2025, the unit (lei, whole numbers), the source (the Ministry of Finance financial statements on data.gov.ro) and `companii`, a collection keyed by CUI with `caen` and `y`, a collection keyed by year; its `fields` list names the ten yearly measures (turnover, total income, total expenses, net profit, net loss, debts, equity, fixed assets, current assets, employees) as values of a list, so they are not field records. `county_boundaries.geojson` (7) is the map layer. The repository `cosettechichirau/companiipublice` was not requested: no link of the page names it, and the brief's „probably” is not evidence. Two provider items D221 (the list) and D222 (the financial statements). Eight candidate members (`cui` 3, `judet` 2, `cod-caen` 2, `perioada-de-referinta` 1).
limite: Cele zece măsuri anuale din `financials.json` sunt declarate ca valori în lista `fields`, nu ca nume de câmp, iar rândurile `y{*}` au zece poziții fără nume. De aceea niciun grup de măsuri (`cifra-afaceri`, `profit-net`, `numar-salariati`, `datorii`, `capitaluri-proprii`) nu are membru aici.
Eșantioane de 200.000 de octeți din `companii.json` și `financials.json`: 436 de rânduri în `companii`; fișierele complete nu au fost citite.
Depozitul `cosettechichirau/companiipublice` nu este legat de pagină și nu a fost cerut.
companii-publice-ro.limite_en: The ten yearly measures of `financials.json` are declared as values of the list `fields`, not as field names, and the rows `y{*}` have ten positions without names, so no measure group has a member here. The files are range samples (436 rows of `companii`). The repository is not linked from the page and was not requested.
companii-publice-ro.urmatorul_pas: Un editor poate adăuga cele zece măsuri din `financials.json` în `campuri-editor.csv`; fragmentul listei `fields` apare în copia păstrată. Apoi le poate propune ca membri ai grupurilor de măsuri. Decideți D221–D222 și cei opt candidați.
companii-publice-ro.urmator_en: An editor can add the ten measures of `financials.json` to `campuri-editor.csv` (the fragment of the list `fields` is in the retained copy) and then propose them as members of the measure groups. Decide D221–D222 and the eight candidates.

executii-bugetare.rezultat: Platform for the budget execution of local authorities (catalogue: `date-publice`; a single-page application of the Oracle JET kind). A plain request returns a shell of 44 characters. The browser render (two navigations: the second after the fix of the render helper) showed the data requests, all static JSON files under `/json/`: `judete.json` (42 counties: code and name), `AN/JUDET/institutii.json` (the institutions of a county: CUI as `cif`, name and two flags) and `AN/JUDET/CUI.json` (revenue and expenditure of one institution by month: `diagrama`, a series of nine monthly sums for each budget line; `tabel`, the lines with sums and sub-lines; `total`; and `date`, the links to the original monthly reports, xlsx and pdf, on `static.anaf.ro`). The home view that the page loads says „Date preluate de pe mfinante.gov.ro/transparenta-bugetara”; the provider L135 (Ministerul Finanțelor) is already accepted, so no provider item was written. Three sources, 30 field records. Candidate members: `cui` (`cif`), `judet`, `perioada-de-referinta` (the months). No group: the budget lines are keys of a keyed collection, that is values, not fields.
limite: Un singur fișier de instituție a fost citit (Primăria Municipiului București, 2026). Celelalte instituții și ani au același tipar de adresă (`json/AN/JUDET/CUI.json`) și nu au fost cerute.
Liniile bugetare sunt chei ale `diagrama` (nume de linii cu coduri între paranteze): sunt valori, nu câmpuri. Inventarul arată colecția cu chei și nu le copiază.
Fișierele nu declară unitatea sau moneda.
Vizualizarea `js/views/home.html` a fost cerută o dată ca dovadă de furnizor, nu ca sursă de câmpuri.
executii-bugetare.limite_en: One institution file was read (Primăria Municipiului București, 2026); the others have the same address pattern and were not requested. The budget lines are keys of a collection, so values, and the inventory shows the collection without copying them. The files declare no unit or currency. The home view was requested once as provider evidence, not as a source of fields.
executii-bugetare.urmatorul_pas: Decideți cei patru candidați (`cui`, `judet` de două ori, `perioada-de-referinta`). Dacă proprietarul vrea, se pot citi alte instituții cu aceeași adresă. Nu este nevoie de un element de furnizor nou (L135 este acceptat).
executii-bugetare.urmator_en: Decide the candidates; other institutions can be read with the same address pattern; no new provider item is needed (L135 is accepted).

ce-cumpara-primaria.rezultat: Purchases of the town halls of Romania, 2025: where the money goes, by service (catalogue: `date-publice`; a Next.js site on Vercel). The page is server-rendered: no JSON request exists, and the data are in HTML tables. Three pages were read with the table reader: the ranking (`/clasament`, 9 field records: place, locality, inhabitants, current spending for each inhabitant, lei for each inhabitant, split, median, comparison, total), the suppliers (`/furnizori`, 6: rank, firm with CUI, amount received, number of administrations, number of purchases, main service) and the page of one administrative unit (`/uat/9262?an=2025`, Arad; 10: services with total and medians, and the firms that were paid). The page declares its sources: the quarterly SEAP/SICAP reports on data.gov.ro, the SIRUTA register and the population by UAT (INS / MDLPA), and company data from ANAF. Four provider items D223–D226. Candidate members: `populatie` (inhabitants) and `localitate` (low confidence). No group.
limite: Datele sunt în tabele HTML cu celule compuse: coloana „Localitate” are numele, tipul, județul și serviciul principal într-un singur text, iar coloana „Firmă” are numele și CUI-ul. Cititorul de tabele dă coloana, nu părțile ei.
O singură pagină de UAT (Arad) a fost citită; paginile celorlalte UAT-uri au aceeași formă. Numărul din adresă (`9262`) seamănă cu un cod SIRUTA, dar nicio pagină nu spune că este codul SIRUTA.
Sumele sunt atribuite, fără cantități („SEAP nu publică unități de măsură”); anul este cel al anunțului, nu al semnăturii.
Paginile `/companii-de-stat` și `/serviciu/…` nu au fost citite.
ce-cumpara-primaria.limite_en: The data are in HTML tables with composite cells (locality with type, county and service; firm with CUI). One UAT page (Arad) was read. The number in the address looks like a SIRUTA code, but no page says so. Amounts are awarded values without quantities; the year is that of the announcement. The state-company and service pages were not read.
ce-cumpara-primaria.urmatorul_pas: Decideți D223–D226 și cei doi candidați. Dacă proprietarul publică fișierele de date (depozit sau export), un inventar ar putea citi coloanele pe celule simple.
ce-cumpara-primaria.urmator_en: Decide D223–D226 and the two candidates. A data export from the owner would give simple columns.

sicap-ai.rezultat: Search engine for tenders and direct awards (catalogue: `date-publice`). Every request of the documentation pass of 2026-10-24 answered HTTP 429 (the page, llms.txt, /metodologie/ and /despre/, 100 ms apart). The batch rule says to stop on a host that answers 429. The host was not requested again in this batch: the state is `blocat`, and the reserve entry `de-unde-vine-apa` took its place (the first reserve, recorded before the replacement). The host has Vercel name servers, as harta-firmelor.ro, which the project lists in `colectare-interzisa.csv` after the same answer. A row for the list is proposed in the report; it was not added.
limite: Nicio cerere nouă nu s-a trimis în acest lot; dovada este pasul de documentare din 2026-10-24 (4 din 4 cereri cu HTTP 429).
sicap-ai.limite_en: No new request was made in this batch; the evidence is the documentation pass of 2026-10-24 (4 of 4 requests answered HTTP 429).
sicap-ai.blocaj: HTTP 429 la toate cele patru cereri ale pasului de documentare din 2026-10-24 (pagina, llms.txt, /metodologie/, /despre/). Regula lotului: oprire pe o gazdă care răspunde 429. Gazda nu a fost cerută din nou.
sicap-ai.blocaj_en: HTTP 429 on all four requests of the documentation pass of 2026-10-24. The batch rule says to stop on such a host; the host was not requested again.
sicap-ai.urmatorul_pas: Proprietarul decide dacă `sicap.ai` intră în `colectare-interzisa.csv` (rând propus în raport) sau dacă salvează din browser pagina și documentația, pentru `--import-saved`.
sicap-ai.urmator_en: The owner decides whether `sicap.ai` joins `colectare-interzisa.csv` (a row is proposed in the report) or saves the page and its documentation from a browser for `--import-saved`.

open-budget.rezultat: Budget visualisation (catalogue: `date-publice`; the host is behind Cloudflare). The four requests of the documentation pass of 2026-10-24 timed out, and so did a new direct request and a browser render in this batch (25-second timeout; the record is `randare/open-budget-*.json`, state `timeout`). Nothing answered: no 401, 403 or 429, so no refusal and no row for `colectare-interzisa.csv`. The state is `blocat`; the reserve entry `ani-de-pensie` took its place (the second reserve, recorded before the replacement).
limite: Gazda nu răspunde unui client automat și nici unui browser fără cap: nu există nicio pagină, nicio sursă și niciun text colectat.
open-budget.limite_en: The host answers neither an automated client nor a headless browser; no page, source or text was collected.
open-budget.blocaj: Expirarea citirii la patru cereri (2026-10-24), la o cerere directă nouă și la o randare în browser (2026-10-27). DNS rezolvă (Cloudflare); niciun răspuns HTTP.
open-budget.blocaj_en: Read timeouts on four requests (2026-10-24), one new direct request and one browser render (2026-10-27). DNS resolves (Cloudflare); no HTTP answer.
open-budget.urmatorul_pas: Proprietarul poate salva pagina din browserul lui și o poate importa cu `--import-saved`, sau poate verifica dacă site-ul mai există.
open-budget.urmator_en: The owner can save the page from their own browser and import it with `--import-saved`, or check whether the site still exists.

monitor-social.rezultat: Social data about Romania, a project whose pages give the address and the e-mail domain of FES Romania (fes.de) (catalogue: `date-publice`; a WordPress site). The data pages (`/data/…`) paste the tables that the Eurostat data browser exports; the indicator pages (`/indicator/…`) hold charts. Four of the seven data pages that the home page lists were read with the new reader `html-tabele-eurostat` (54 field records): household consumption (hbs_exp_t111, hbs_str_t211, hbs_str_t223, hbs_str_t226), the employment rate by sex and age (LFSI_EMP_A, two extractions of one code), the population by educational attainment (EDAT_LFSE_03, EDAT_LFSE_04) and residence permits (MIGR_RESOCC, tps00171). Each extraction gives one measure (title, code, unit, extraction date, source `ESTAT`) and its dimensions (TIME, GEO, COICOP, Sex, Age class and others); no value is copied. The four pages hold 10 extractions and 9 data sets. The pasted tables have several shapes (the extraction line first, a title row with the code, stacked extractions, Romanian labels), and the reader was extended for them. Provider: Eurostat (D227). One candidate (`perioada-de-referinta`), and members of the new proposed groups `sex` and `grupa-de-varsta`.
limite: Trei din cele șapte pagini de date nu au fost citite. Cele patru pagini citite au 10 extracții Eurostat, care dau 9 seturi (pagina despre ocuparea femeilor lipește același cod de două ori).
Un tabel fără rând `(Labels)` sau `TIME` nu este citit; sursa se marchează parțială. Cititorul nu citește valori: dimensiunea rândurilor (țări) fără titlu rămâne nenumită.
Unitatea lipsește la extracțiile despre studii (rândul `Unit of measure` nu are valoare).
Paginile `/indicator/…` (grafice) nu au fost cerute.
monitor-social.limite_en: Three of the seven data pages were not read. A table with no `(Labels)` row or `TIME` row is not read and the source is marked partial. No value is read; the dimension of the rows (countries) with no heading stays unnamed. The two extractions on educational attainment have no unit value. The indicator pages were not requested.
monitor-social.urmatorul_pas: Citiți celelalte trei pagini de date dacă vreți toți indicatorii. Decideți D227, candidatul pentru perioadă și grupurile `sex` și `grupa-de-varsta`.
monitor-social.urmator_en: Read the other three data pages for all indicators. Decide D227, the candidate for the period and the groups `sex` and `grupa-de-varsta`.

verifica-psiholog.rezultat: Independent search of the Romanian psychologists registered with the CPR (catalogue: `date-publice`; a Next.js site). The terms page (one request) bans copying for commercial use and redistribution; it does not ban automated access. One browser navigation of the home page (without text: `--fara-text`) showed the data requests, among them the registry list `GET /api/psychologists-grouped?limit=1000` (2,407,883 bytes: more than 1,000 records about natural persons; the browser helper left it out for its size). The first 4,000 bytes were read by a range request, enough for the first record: 65 field records of a psychologist with a list of certificates (identifiers, name fields, branch, county, certificate fields, flags for the special registers, seniority, update fields). That source is marked `persoane`: the record keeps names, paths, types and counts and no value.
